_template_notes.purpose: SSOT pipeline state cho wf-cmi (8 phases). Owned by orchestrator (Phase 1 init), updated atomically sau mỗi POST-GATE. v2.0 schema bump: thêm lanes_active_v2[] + wave_status{} + migration_check. Tham chiếu 04-file-contract.md §4.1 + 03-phase-routing.md §5.
populate: profile từ args (default standard); v2.0: deep=26 lanes (BREAKING từ v1.0 deep=10)
dims_active dựa profile activation matrix (xem _contract.json.profile_activation): quick=7 lanes / standard=13 / deep=26 (Gói C++) / exhaustive=35 (deep+9 SKIPPED enable)
lanes_active_v2 (NEW v2.0): array CD IDs từ profile (lookup _contract.json.profile_activation.[profile].lanes_active)
wave_status (NEW v2.0): per-wave execution tracking {wave1, wave2, wave3} với started_at/completed_at/lane_count/pass_count/fail_count
lane_status start với 'pending' cho mọi active lane, update theo flow pending→running→completed|failed|timeout|skipped
ci_context populate từ Phase 1 CI PRE-GATE Na/Nb/Nc
phases_completed APPEND theo thứ tự sau mỗi POST-GATE PASS
current_phase cập nhật sau khi PRE-GATE phase mới PASS
current_wave (NEW v2.0): trong Phase 4 — 1/2/3, null ngoài Phase 4
migration_check (NEW v2.0): nếu --resume session v1.0 với binary v2.0 → set migration_warning='E110_v1_session_with_v2_binary'

schema_version_history.v2: 2.0.0 (2026-05-16) — 26 active lanes Gói C++ Logistics + 9 SKIPPED + 5 skeleton CD32-CD36 v3-deferred. Added: lanes_active_v2[], wave_status{}, current_wave, migration_check
